items.title: 2 Hours of Calm History for Sleep | Ancient Rome, a Medieval Monastery & the Nile
items.description:
Three quiet nights from the past, gathered into one long and gentle evening. First, walk through ancient Rome as the lamps go out along the Appian Way and the harbour at Ostia settles for the night. Then stay inside a medieval monastery, from vespers and the scriptorium to the great silence and the bell in the dark. Last, rest beside the Nile in ancient Egypt, with the tomb builders' village, a temple by lamplight and slow boats under the stars. When the stories end, a long, soft ambient rest lets you stay asleep.
